scenarios.name: a new employee gets the next number, and amounts to the fils
an employee changed
an employee marked as left, today
refused: no name
scenarios.error: Enter the employee’s name.

scenarios.name: refused: a number already used
scenarios.error: Employee number emp-001 is already used.

scenarios.name: refused: changed somewhere else
scenarios.error: This employee was changed somewhere else after you opened the form. Reload the page to see the changes, then make yours again.

scenarios.name: refused: fewer than 30 days of leave a year
scenarios.error: Annual leave can’t be less than 30 days a year (art. 70).

scenarios.name: own leave days removed, and their date with them
leave brought forward
refused: leave brought forward without days
scenarios.error: Enter the number of days.

scenarios.name: a photo given, replacing the one before
a photo removed
an employee deleted with their file
refused: deleting an employee with payroll history
scenarios.error: This employee has payroll records, which are part of the accounts. Mark them as left instead.

scenarios.name: a department added
departments added from the employees
a department renamed, with its employees
refused: a department name already used
scenarios.error: There is already a department called Head Office.

scenarios.name: a department archived
a spelling merged into a department
employees put in a department
People settings saved, tidy
the search across companies turned on
payroll settings saved, tidy
a leave policy saved
refused: a leave policy under 30 days
scenarios.error: Annual leave can’t be less than 30 days a year (art. 70).

scenarios.name: refused: changing how annual leave is counted once recorded
scenarios.error: Annual leave has been recorded, so the way it is counted can’t change.

scenarios.name: leave reasons switched on
refused: a reason leave is recorded with taken off the list
scenarios.error: Leave is recorded with Emergency leave, so it can’t be removed. Archive it instead.

scenarios.name: a reason archived
unpaid leave in calendar days, a holiday included
sick leave in working days, without the holiday
refused: leave on weekends only
scenarios.error: These dates are all weekends or public holidays.

scenarios.name: refused: the last day before the first
scenarios.error: The last day can’t be before the first day.

scenarios.name: an opening balance replaces leave brought forward nobody confirmed
days added by hand to a reason paid from them
leave on half pay of a reason
refused: a reason that needs a note
scenarios.error: Enter a note: Study leave needs one.

scenarios.name: refused: a reason not for the employee’s category
scenarios.error: Days in lieu isn’t for employees of this category.

scenarios.name: refused: leave that changes an approved pay run
scenarios.error: This leave changes the pay of Sample Expat in the September 2026 pay run, which is already approved. Reopen the pay run first, then update it after the leave.

scenarios.name: leave cancelled
the same leave brought forward for everyone who needs it
each one’s leave brought forward from a spreadsheet
a loan paid from the bank
a loan whose staff advances account was deleted makes it again
a loan’s instalment changed
refused: an instalment over the loan
scenarios.error: The instalment can’t be more than the loan.

scenarios.name: refused: a loan in the locked period
scenarios.error: The books are locked up to 30/09/2026. Change the lock date in Settings → Accounting to post on an earlier date.

scenarios.name: a loan cancelled
refused: cancelling a loan partly recovered
scenarios.error: Part of this loan was recovered, so it can’t be cancelled.

scenarios.name: a pay run prepared
